map.数据明明不服从正态分布怎么办？: What if the data clearly is not normally distributed?
map.先检验再套用。可用直方图、Q-Q 图或 Shapiro-Wilk 等检验判断；若: Test first, then apply. Use histograms, Q-Q plots or tests such as Shapiro-Wilk; if the data is clearly skewed or heavy-tailed, forcing a normal model badly underestimates the probability of extreme values (very common with financial and latency data). Alternatives are to apply a transformation such as the logarithm first, or to switch to a better-fitting model such as the t distribution or the lognormal.
